evals.prompt: Onboard to this codebase (app.py, worker.py, README.md are in your working directory): map the components, entry points, conventions, and risks, and seed the knowledge vault with grounded notes.
evals.expected_output: An onboarding map naming the real components — the Flask HTTP API (app.py) and the background worker (worker.py) — a real entry point (app.py / `python app.py`), and a real risk (the worker has no retry/backoff, so a failed job is lost). Knowledge-vault notes are seeded and validate clean. Nothing is invented beyond the code.
assertions: Identifies the real components from the code: the HTTP API (app.py) and the background worker (worker.py)
Names a real entry point (e.g. app.py / running `python app.py`)
Flags a real risk grounded in the code (the worker has no retry/backoff — a failed job is lost)
Seeds the knowledge vault with notes that validate clean (validate_vault: linked, no orphans)
Produces a valid onboarding artifact (type onboarding, non-empty components); nothing fabricated beyond the code
